title: Governed production security hotfix candidate classification

phases.objective: Classify exact-SHA Production security lockfile review candidates with strict negative scope testing without granting Promotion or Deployment authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: PR head candidate plus immutable Production base SHA into reviewer classification
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Eligible candidate may pass scoped classification while production_promotion and production_security_hotfix_authority_eligible remain false.
steps: Build isolated git origin and Production review candidate
Reject out-of-scope files, moved Production base, added dependency, unsafe tarball, downgrade and changed package root metadata
Require legacy classifier identity mismatch to be only finding before conditional candidate classification
Verify no trusted attestation or Production mutation implied
assertions: Current remote Production base must exactly match candidate ancestry
Changes restricted to existing npm lockfiles and monotonic version upgrades
All invalid candidates fail closed; old release-cut invariants preserved
Production merge and deployment require separate owner and GitHub App proof
